description:
Harden the OpenAI Responses WebSocket lane as a first-class transport expression of the same semantic API.

Scope:
- pressure-test websocket surface selection through ExecutionPlan
- validate frame decoding, event ordering, and canonical normalization
- support continuation/session mechanics that are appropriate for the current architecture
- define fallback behavior or explicit exclusions where websocket mode differs from HTTP
- keep transport differences isolated from semantic protocol and public API shape

Goal:
- prove that the same semantic family can run over a different transport without collapsing concerns
title: Harden OpenAI Responses WebSocket transport support
